author: The Current
description:
Amelia Meath of Sylvan Esso recalls the time she was on PBS' "Antiques Roadshow"
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

On Saturday, Sylvan Esso played a concert at First Avenue that was broadcast live on The Current. Earlier in the day, Sylvan Esso’s Amelia Meath visited The Current studio to chat live on the air with host Bill DeVille. During their conversation, Meath reminisced about the time she and Nick Sanborn from @sylvanesso appeared on another public-media outlet: on “Antiques Roadshow” on PBS. 

Watch Amelia Meath tell the full story in the video above.
